note: Both sets capture the same four datum values, but Set A binds each value to the correct property name as labeled on the drawing ("finished floor elevation", "grade level elevation") and its quotes include the room label (KITCHEN/BEDROOM) that supports the entity binding. Set B renames the property as "finished floor height" and adds the condition "relative to grade level," an interpretation not stated on the sheet, while its grade-level quotes omit any room label, leaving the Kitchen/Bedroom binding unsupported. Set A is therefore the more faithful extraction, with no invented content.
